description: Initialize npm project and install dev dependencies
prompt: Run `npm init -y`. Install `eslint`, `prettier`, `vitest` as dev dependencies. Add standard scripts to package.json.
Create .eslintrc.json and .prettierrc. Configure for browser/webextension environment. Ignore `lib/` directory.

description: Run initial lint and fix auto-fixable issues
prompt: Run `npx eslint . --fix`. Fix any minor formatting issues manually if needed.
Create `tests/storage.test.js`. Write unit tests for `storage.js` functions using Vitest. Mock chrome.storage API.
Investigate `popup.js` usage of `getPrompt`. It is not defined in `storage.js` exports. Implement `getPrompt` in `storage.js` or update `popup.js` to use `getAllPrompts`.
